Kim — I've sketched three scenario rows in plain text below so we can iterate before I populate the sheet. Numbers are ballpark and assume EU pricing/instance mix. I'll attach the more detailed workbook after we lock assumptions.

Scenario A — Hosted (per-token API)
- Price: €0.0006 / token (gen+prompt blended)
- Pilot volume: 120M tokens/month => cost = €72k/month
- Pros: zero infra lead time, instant scale; Cons: highest marginal unit cost, limited cache/throughput tuning for peak concurrency.

Scenario B — Dedicated (reserved GPU commit)
- Commit bands: 1x A100-equivalent pool for pilot (shared across Elara services) => pricing example: €35k/month reserved (with 10% overage per token priced at €0.00015/token)
- Effective cost at 120M tokens: reserved cost €35k + overage 0 => €35k/month (break-even vs Hosted at ~58M tokens/month)
- Pros: lower unit cost, predictable latency, can enable KV/prefix caching to reduce token consumption; Cons: 2-4 week lead time for capacity allocation in EU region.

Scenario C — Private (VPC / on-prem)
- One-time onboarding/license: €120k + annual platform+ops €20k/month (includes support, patching)
- At pilot-scale (120M tokens) effective monthly run-rate in year 1 = amortized onboarding (~€10k/month) + ops €20k + infra variable (est. €10k) => ~€40k/month
- Pros: maximum control, isolation, compliance posture; Cons: high upfront, longer procurement cycle, SRE involvement.

Sensitivity notes:
- If token volume grows to 300M/month, Dedicated becomes ~2.5x cheaper than Hosted in our example banding.
- Peak concurrency affects sizing (need more instances to keep p95 latency targets) — this can push Dedicated pricing higher if the customer requires headroom beyond average utilization.

Next actions I suggest before Thursday:
- Kimberly: confirm whether Elara wants a 1- or 3-month pilot commit band for the Dedicated quote (we'll price both).
- Karthik: I'll produce side-by-side cost table + a simple break-even graph and upload to the HubSpot deal.
- Marissa: can you draft a short note on lead times for EU Dedicated pool provisioning and any quota constraints?
